activities.anchor: owes an account of why anaesthesia, sleep and narcolepsy
activities.caption: your theory meets the off-switch — decide
activities.name: chOrexinBranch

config.root: You hold a theory: consciousness is purely cortical content. A new fact arrives — losing the lateral hypothalamus's orexin neurons drops patients into sleep dozens of times a day.

start.text: What does the theory owe this fact?

choices.label: An account of the off-switch: the arousal substrate joins the theory
choices.feedback: Consciousness is a partnership in which hypothalamic and brainstem arousal systems hold the door open and cortical networks do the content.

choices.label: Nothing — arousal is mere plumbing beneath a content theory
choices.feedback: Wakefulness can be switched off dozens of times a day while every representation stays in place.

partnership.text: The wake-promoting orexin/hypocretin neurons of the lateral hypothalamus are the decisive case: their loss causes narcolepsy. Content and arousal are partners, not rivals.

gap.text: The representations remain while consciousness vanishes — the theory explains the content but not the switch, and the unexplained switch is the phenomenon to explain.

config.why: Consciousness is not a cortical monopoly: arousal machinery holds the door open, cortical networks supply what comes through it.

activities.caption: true or false — the chemistry of state
activities.name: chHormoneJudge

statements.s: Circadian and ultradian hormonal rhythms measurably alter attention, mood and the very sense of effort.
statements.why: The same workload feels different at different points in the cycle of corticotropin release.

statements.s: Hormonal chemistry is backdrop to consciousness rather than part of it.
statements.why: It is part of it: subjective state is an envelope set by chemistry and maintained homeostatically.

statements.s: There is a single 'consciousness module' in the brain.
statements.why: No such module: state is shifted by everything from sleep debt to infection.

statements.s: Treating thyroid failure is consciousness engineering of a humble but literal kind.
statements.why: Clinical neuroendocrinology moves the envelope that experience happens inside.

activities.anchor: bodily signals bias decisions before conscious reasoning
activities.caption: pair each tradition with its claim
activities.name: chInteroMatch

config.prompt: The feelings beneath awareness. Pair each research tradition with what it holds:

pairs.right: emotion is the perception of bodily state
insular mapping of temperature, pain and visceral state
bodily signals bias decisions before reasoning reports them

pairs.left: autonomic arousal to a heard name
pairs.right: how covert awareness is detected in a patient who cannot speak

config.why: Affect is the clearest case of experience with minimal reportability — the empirical wedge into feeling that never becomes speech.

activities.anchor: The regulator is the target, not the temperature itself
activities.caption: drag the divider — two readings of a fever
activities.name: chFeverCompare

config.prompt: Warm-blooded means constant temperature — or does it? Drag the divider between the two readings:

before.label: Broken thermostat
before.text: Fever as malfunction: the body's regulation has failed, so the temperature is simply wrong and must be forced back down.

after.label: Raised set point
after.text: The hypothalamus defends a moving target: core temperature swings by about a degree across the day, and a fever is a deliberately raised set point — which is why you shiver while burning up.

config.why: The regulator is the target, not the temperature itself — shivering is active heat generation in service of the new set point.

activities.caption: find the faulty line — a hunger researcher's log
activities.name: chFeedingSpot

config.prompt: A researcher's summary of feeding control contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: Leptin signals from fat; ghrelin from the empty stomach.
Hypothalamic AgRP/POMC neurons turn appetite on and off within seconds of stimulation.
Hunger is felt consciously, so the regulatory arithmetic — energy stores, nutrient sensing, meal timing — is consciously computed.
Obesity medicine has shifted from willpower to circuit biology.
config.correction: The regulatory arithmetic runs in hypothalamic and brainstem loops no introspection reaches — the feeling of hunger is the occasional conscious surfacing, not the computation.
config.why: Motivation operates largely beneath awareness: when studying any conscious state, ask what unconscious regulatory variables set it.

activities.anchor: every bedside test of awareness is partly a test of memory
activities.caption: fill the blanks — continuity and its loss
activities.name: chHmCloze

config.text: Patient %%0%% stayed fully alert and intelligent but could form almost no new %%1%% memories — a permanent present. The same lesson reads in %%2%%'s seconds-long awareness, endlessly rewakening.
config.hint: One patient is known by initials and a 1953 resection; the other by a seconds-long awareness inside an otherwise intact mind.

activities.anchor: The workspace is a testable claim, not a metaphor
activities.caption: file each signature — unconscious or conscious
activities.name: chWorkspaceBuckets

config.prompt: Global Workspace Theory says broadcast — late, widespread, serial. File each experimental signature:

items.label: subliminal primes speed reactions they never reach awareness
masked words activate meaning but not report
priming, conditioning and skill acquisition proceeding under anaesthesia
broadcast of information to a wide set of processors
declarative learning — the sort you can state

config.why: Only declarative learning routinely requires awareness — the dissociation between cheap local processing and late widespread broadcast is the workspace's experimental signature.

activities.anchor: Excitotoxicity is the lethal link between the two
activities.caption: rebuild the cascade — stroke at the cellular edge
activities.name: chStrokeOrder

config.prompt: How signalling turns lethal when regulation fails. Rebuild the cascade:
items: Neurons flood with calcium and die
config.why: The same transmitter that carries every perception kills when regulation fails — which is why stroke care is clock-bound: time is brain.
